title: Constitutive Priors for Machine Intelligence: A Legitimacy Theory of the Artificial Physical World
abstract: arXiv:2608.15147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine intelligence has conquered the symbolic world but stalled at the physical one. The stall is structural: physical AI faces a cold-start deadlock -- no intelligence without data, no data without deployed intelligence. Our thesis: the deadlock is real but unevenly distributed, and the exception has a name: the artificial physical world. Buildings, industrial facilities, and infrastructure are intentionally constituted and documented: designed artifacts ship with readable archives that precede and constitute their instances; here, norms are promulgated before instances, not averaged from them. translated_title: 机器智能的构成性先验：人工物理世界的合法性理论
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15147v1 公告类型：新 摘要：机器智能已征服符号世界，但在物理世界停滞不前。这种停滞是结构性的：物理人工智能面临冷启动僵局——没有数据就没有智能，没有部署的智能就没有数据。我们的论点：僵局是真实存在的，但分布不均，而例外有一个名字：人工物理世界。建筑物、工业设施和基础设施是有意构成和记录的：设计的人工制品带有可读的档案，这些档案先于并构成其实例；在这里，规范在实例之前颁布，而不是从实例中平均得出。四项贡献。(i) 从四世界本体论中，我们推导出构成性先验框架的合法性标准：当且仅当对象领域是有意构成的并留有可读档案时，先验提取才是合法的；该标准可通过适配方向进行测试——偏离构成性规范即为违规。
tldr: 本文提出，人工物理世界因其有意的构成和可读档案，为物理人工智能提供了合法的构成性先验，从而打破了冷启动僵局。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that the artificial physical world, due to its intentional constitution and readable archives, provides legitimate constitutive priors for physical AI, thereby breaking the cold-start deadlock.
